We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Or carbon NMR to see methyl carbons. Use tools.

We need to minimize experiments. Perhaps we can get proton NMR first. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we have no SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it.

Let's do that.
